collection_method: macOS built-in tools fallback (system_profiler, memory_pressure, vm_stat, df)
collection_note: The bundled detector could not run because psutil was unavailable; a temporary dependency download stalled and was terminated.

memory.note: Available memory is estimated from memory_pressure and varies over time.

parallel_processing.note: Start with 6-8 workers for independent CPU tasks; reduce this for memory-heavy MRI arrays.

memory_strategy.note: Do not load many full complex CINE cases simultaneously. Process subjects incrementally and use chunking for multi-case arrays.

gpu_acceleration.note: Metal/MPS may help compatible local experiments, but this machine has no CUDA/NVIDIA GPU and is not the target for full repository inference.

large_data_handling.note: Disk space is ample, but raw server data is not local. Prefer derived summaries and per-case processing over copying server datasets.
